description: Parameters of the engine. Each block states whether its values come from the literature or are assumptions of this project.

renal_function_probabilities.basis: Powell et al. (2022), baseline distribution of the pooled population

spo2.basis: chosen so that about 5% are below 95%, as in Powell et al. (2022)

breast.basis: chosen so that about 39% are above 4 years, as in Powell et al. (2022)

severe_toxicity.basis: assumption. The odds ratios for age and geriatric impairments are chosen so that a patient like the average GAP70+ participant (age 77, 4.5 impaired domains, regimen rate 60%) has a risk of about 74%, close to the 71% of the usual-care arm in Mohile et al. (2021).

hazard_ratios.basis: Powell et al. (2022), multivariable Cox model, Figure 3B

onset_days.basis: median from Modi et al. (2022); sigma of the log-normal distribution chosen so that 87% of events start within 12 months, as in Powell et al. (2022)

grade_probabilities.basis: Modi et al. (2022): 13 grade 1, 24 grade 2, 5 grade 3 and 3 grade 5 events among 45 patients
